notes.title: Their Legend, Your Life: Free ROCKY™ Legends Update Now Live in CREED: Rise to Glory
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32933238/3e18890b442f0f88797f2cbecfcc22e1b67561a1.jpg[/img]

[i]“Watch yourself―you ready?” - Apollo Creed[/i]

You must break them―or become them. Today, Tuesday, January 29, [i]CREED: Rise to Glory™[/i] brings the most iconic figures of the [i]ROCKY[/i] cinematic universe to the game’s Freeplay and PvP roster in its latest free content update.

https://youtu.be/V8kxkp4OOnQ
For any players who have dreamed of duking it out against or pulling on the gloves as the Italian Stallion himself, now everyone has Classic Rocky Balboa on their rosters. Aspiring title fighters can also take on World Heavyweight Champion Apollo Creed, father of Adonis Creed and Rocky’s original rival-turned-friend; [i]Rocky III[/i]’s streetwise Southside Slugger Clubber Lang; and, most notorious of all, Ivan Drago himself from [i]Rocky IV[/i].

Each [i]ROCKY[/i] Legends character is available in [i]CREED: Rise to Glory[/i] as both a Freeplay opponent and playable character. Or, if you want to make these rematches as personal as possible, play as all the legends in PvP and see who truly means business. 

The [i]ROCKY[/i] Legends update is now live on Steam, Oculus Home, and PlayStation VR, so study up, stand with the best, and remember: it ain’t over ’til it’s over!

[u][b]Patch Notes for [i]CREED: Rise to Glory[/i] v1.6 (PC)/v1.08 (PSVR) (released January 29, 2019)[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Classic Rocky Balboa, Apollo Creed, Clubber Lang, and Ivan Drago fighters added to PvP and Freeplay
[*]Numerous bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Free CREED II Update Now Live!
notes.content:
You saw the fights—now it’s your turn. 🥊 Relive the iconic scenes of [i]Creed II[/i] against Viktor Drago and Danny “Stuntman” Wheeler in [i]CREED: Rise to Glory[/i]’s first FREE update, now available on all platforms! Both fighters are available as new opponents in Freeplay mode and as playable characters in PvP. Think you're tough enough to take them on?

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aliRObJgaRY
[b][u]Update Notes for [i]CREED: Rise to Glory[/i] v1.5 (PC)/v1.07 (PSVR) (released November 27, 2018)[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][i]New Characters[/i]: Added Danny "Stuntman" Wheeler and Viktor Drago from [i]Creed II[/i] as Freeplay opponents and playable PvP characters.
[/list]
Once you've gotten over ogling Drago's abs and dodging Wheeler's insane reach, be sure to send us feedback and bug reports to support@survios.com. Thanks so much, enjoy the new fighters, and stay tuned for more good stuff coming early next year!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.4 Now Live: PvP Connection Improvements
notes.content:
[i]CREED[/i] team here! Based on community feedback, we just pushed a small patch that should lessen the time it takes to find and connect to PvP matches. This is not our only fix for this issue--we're currently working on a more comprehensive hotfix to improve PvP connection even further--but we wanted to get something out to make your experience better in the meantime, especially with the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/804490/announcements/detail/1717455564435357360][i]CREED II[/i] Update[/url] coming next week!

[b][u]Patch Notes for [i]CREED: Rise to Glory[/i] v1.4 (PC)/v1.06 (PSVR) (released November 16, 2018)[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][i]Quickplay[/i]: Made improvements to PvP match location and connection times.
[/list]
As always, please let us know how it's all working on your end by sending feedback and bug reports to support@survios.com. Thanks so much, and see you back in the ring soon!

notes.title: Fight as CREED II’s Viktor Drago and Danny Wheeler in CREED: Rise to Glory’s November 27th Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32933238/e0bb575dbe829ad22d997cd7f48e852bbbf32013.jpg[/img]

On November 27, [i]CREED: Rise to Glory[/i]’s first free content update adds the blockbuster sequel’s antagonists Viktor Drago and Danny “Stuntman” Wheeler to the game’s Freeplay and PvP opponents across all VR platforms.

In [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u22BXhMu4tI][i]CREED II[/i][/url] (coming to theaters November 21), Adonis Creed finally faces off against his old Delphi Gym rival Danny Wheeler (Andre Ward) as the leadup for a much larger showdown with his past: Viktor Drago, son of Ivan “The Siberian Express” Drago, the Soviet boxer who killed Adonis’ father Apollo during an exhibition bout.

[i]CREED: Rise to Glory[/i] brings the drama of these climactic bouts to your playspace with two Freeplay opponents inspired by their cinematic equivalents. Plus, play as Viktor Drago and Danny Wheeler in PvP, where you’re sure to score some staggers with just an intimidating glare (and a [i]CREED II[/i] catchphrase or two).

The [i]CREED II[/i] update arrives November 27, so get ready to prove what you’re fighting for! Find fellow contenders on the official [url=http://discord.gg/survios]Survios Discord[/url], and stay tuned for upcoming Black Friday sale news.

notes.title: Hotfix Now Live with PvP Improvements!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32933238/2a6f33a2391a791e528182878ed538e4f4576031.gif[/img]

Ladies and gentlemen, it’s the moment you’ve been waiting for: the first big [i]CREED: Rise to Glory[/i] hotfix! This all-platform, PvP-centric patch is designed to give all you aspiring title fighters a fairer, more enjoyable boxing experience. All updates are outlined below:

[b][u]Patch Notes for [i]CREED: Rise to Glory[/i] v1.1.3 (PC)/v1.05 (PSVR) (released November 5, 2018)[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][i]Knockout Tunnel Run[/i]: Button press is no longer required to run back through the knockout tunnel in all game modes.
[*][i]Hammerfist Exploit[/i]: Made improvements to better detect the “hammerfist” exploit in PvP.
[*][i]Stagger[/i]: Introduced a cooldown for becoming staggered in PvP.
[*][i]Blocking[/i]: Adjusted blocking volumes in PvP.
[*][i]Quickplay[/i]: Matching now searches for nearest opponent based on players’ pings.
[/list]
Thanks so much for your continued support, please keep the feedback coming at support@survios.com, and stay tuned for upcoming content news!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1 Now Live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

[i]Creed[/i] dev team here. We hope you (and your upper body muscles) are all thoroughly enjoying going the distance in [i]CREED: Rise to Glory[/i]’s Career mode and taking your fights to the next level in PvP. Thanks to your helpful reports in this release week, we’ve put together a PC hotfix that addresses several persistent issues brought to our attention.

Here’s what’s coming your way:

[u][i]CREED: Rise to Glory[/i] v1.1 (released September 28, 2018)[/u]
[list]
[*][i]Windows Mixed Reality (WMR):[/i] Fast patch to address performance incompatibilities with WMR headsets. We appreciate your reports and feedback, and please continue sending them to support@survios.com so we can work on more WMR bugs.
[*][i]PvP Animation:[/i] Fixed KO/KD animations in PvP causing characters to clip into the mat
[*][i]PvP Blocking:[/i] Adjusted low blocking in PvP to be more responsive
[*][i]General Fixes:[/i] Many minor bug and balance fixes to improve overall performance
[/list]
We’ll have more hotfixes coming your way soon. Your reports help greatly expedite the patching process, so in the meantime, please keep us informed of any glitches or issues you encounter by emailing us at support@survios.com. Thanks so much, and remember: stay focused and hydrated!
